profile.headline: Supercomputing Engineer at SF Compute
profile.summary: Hyper focused on building robust Enterprise and Security solutions with Blockchain technology.

positions.title: Supercomputing Engineer
positions.description:
The San Francisco Compute Company is building the company which will de-risk the largest infrastructure build‑out in history. SFC operates and sells time on massive GPU clusters like a cloud provider, with our own virtualization and bare-metal stack. Our customers purchase compute capacity through long-term contracts with the option to "exit", by selling capacity to others through a liquid market.

In the role of Supercomputing Engineer, I develop and optimize the deployment of platforms to support the high-performance computing infrastructure that our customers demand. Technologies used in this effort include Kubernetes, Slurm, Weka, QEMU, FluentBit, Prometheus, Grafana, Docker/Podman, ArgoCD, Terraform, Ansible, PostgreSQL, AWS, and Rust.

positions.title: Sr. Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Capital One aims to change banking for good by bringing humanity, ingenuity and simplicity to banking. Capital One AI/ML spearheads tech strategy and scaling of enterprise AI/ML platform common capabilities and compute convergence, the evolution of GenAI development and prototyping environments, AI/ML artifact and experiment management, and oversight of AI SDKs and reusable workflows.
positions.insights: Skills: Kubernetes · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Incident Management · Machine Learning · Generative AI Tools

positions.title: Senior Compute Platform Engineer (Onyx Research AI/ML Platform)
positions.description: GSK unites science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. The Onyx Research Data Platform aims to deliver a step-change in ability to leverage data, knowledge, and prediction to find new medicines. The Compute Platform Engineering team is building a first-in-class platform of toolchains and workflows that accelerate application development, scale up computational experiments, and integrate all computation with project metadata, logs, experiment configuration and performance tracking over abstractions that encompass Cloud and High-Performance Computing.
positions.insights: Skills: Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Microsoft Azure · Azure DevOps Services · Posit

positions.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description: Increase resilience and scale of core infrastructure.

positions.title: Member, Big Data Advisory Board
positions.description:
I volunteer to help recruit for the Big Data certificate program presented in San Francisco by Rutgers University.

This program provides great opportunities for those seeking to level-up skills in creating and optimizing data-driven organizations, or wanting to upgrade from BigData operations to leadership roles.

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
Auro Robotics is a division of Ridecell that develops Autonomous
Vehicle technology.

The DevOps role manages network, build/test, and data processing
infrastructure used in the provision, delivery, and management of
autonomous vehicles. Technologies used include ROS, C++, Python, Java,
Common Lisp, Git, Jenkins, Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, Ubuntu/Linux,
and OpenBSD.

positions.title: Head Of Development
positions.description:
Q bio builds technology that quantifies, digitizes and simulates human physiology.
As Engineering Lead, I work on development, day-to-day operations and strategic planning for product.

In this position, I lead developers and report directly to the CEO.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Q bio builds technology that quantifies, digitizes and simulates human physiology.

I work as a developer building data pipelines, executable process models, services and tools.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Work as part of SWAT teams in Capital One Digital Engineering (CODE) to rapidly onboard new mobile apps and web services in support of new business initiatives. My individual contribution is AWS cloud architecture, continuous deployment and production engineering.

positions.title: VP Engineering
positions.description: Responsible for building out the company's end-to-end financial markets focused data analytics platform, including a core set of distributed processing and storage components, quantitative investing toolset, and web application tier. In addition, I develop and mentor an engineering team to execute on platform ramp-up and to drive innovative solutions for the global financial services industry.

positions.title: Technical Account Manager
positions.description:
Develop deep understanding of Hadoop and it's next generation capabilities

Develop reference application and sample code focused on new capabilities

Publish blogs & present at Hadoop User Group to promote awareness and spur developer adoption

Collaborate with ecosystem partners to develop joint solutions, reference architectures & best practice guides

Align product roadmap with key partners and certify joint solutions

Champion partner requirements and be the voice of the partner at Hortonworks

Evangelize and enable alliance channel on the value of Hortonworks Data platform

positions.title: Infrastructure Lead, Analytics
positions.description:
Lead systems engineer responsible for NGpipes analytics infrastructure including Hadoop and HBase clusters at world leading social mobile gaming company. 

Responsible for grid operations, capacity planning and disaster recovery planning for analytics infrastructure. 

Manage and mentor DevOps engineers in large scale systems architecture and bigdata applications. 

Hack Java, Scala, Python, Ruby, Clojure, bash, perl, awk as needed to maintain multiple data pipelines from ingestion, ETL to post processing and ad hoc.

Contribute code and scripts to data pipeline jobs and workflows.

Lead and encourage research into leading edge applications of bigdata.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Analytics
positions.description:
Maintain and extend analytics platforms Mobage & Abacus

Develop and maintain Java MapReduce code for ETL, analytics pipeline. 

Analytics processing using Hadoop, HBase, Hive, Pig

Deploy and extend Hadoop platforns: HDFS, Oozie, ZooKeeper, Hive, Hue, Puppet

Implement configuration management lifecycle for grid using Puppet, Vagrant

Participate in on-call rotation, provide backline support for on-call

Application development in Scala, Avro & Protocol Buffers

Design and implement Disaster Recovery, BCP for Analytics full data lifecycle

Mentor team in grid technology, software process and functional programming

Tools development via Java, scripting in python, shell

positions.title: Staff Engineer, Platform
positions.description:
Lead efforts to optimize and extend StubHub APIs and services across traditional web, mobile, tablet and emerging client platforms.

Innovate the StubHub platform to empower internal and third party developers.

Play a leading role in improving and modernizing StubHub's architecture.

Work across multiple domains including product development, release engineering, and technical operations to coordinate the move from
continuous integration to continuous deployment, migration from classic n-tier to cloud fabric deployment, and further platform modernization that builds on previous development efforts to provide a next generation platform that can empower a $10B business.

positions.title: Cloud Computing Yahoo!
positions.description:
Hadoop Engineering Yahoo! working within the company's Cloud Computing group. Primary focus is the open source Apache Hadoop project for cloud computing infrastructure implemented in Java.

My current activities involve SQE work focused on improving quality of Hadoop Map Reduce APIs especially as deployed in very large scale clusters (>>2000 nodes).

Learn more about Hadoop at http://hadoop.apache.org/.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I lead architecture and development for multiple mission critical applications.

Bill Me Later is a convenient and secure way to pay on the web or over the phone. Bill Me Later lets users pay without using a credit card. At checkout, provide your birthday and the last four digits of your social security number, accept the terms and your purchase is complete. It’s that easy! There are no codes to find or account numbers to remember.

Millions of shoppers love Bill Me Later because it’s fast, simple and secure. Leading web stores and catalogs love Bill Me Later because they want to offer easy, safe, and convenient options for their customers at check-out.

Bill Me Later Shopping is a great start to your Internet shopping. We work with your favorite stores to offer hundreds of exclusive and exciting specials and deals for Bill Me Later users.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
I work as an Java developer working on internal and customer facing applications across multiples business areas of the organization. I work as part of small, highly focused team using Scrum style of Agile methodology. Development technologies include Struts2/Webwork, Spring, Hibernate, Freemarker and SQL Server database.

Intrax provides students, young adults, families, and organizations with dynamic exchange opportunities which inspire personal growth, mutual respect, and cultural understanding. Find out more at http://www.intraxinc.com/.

positions.title: Technical Advisor
positions.description: Consulted Entrepreneur/CEO, giving guidance on business strategy and platform evolution

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: I lead a team of developers working within the Long-Tail Applications group. We are delivering a number of new services to the Rearden Commerce Personal Assistant platform. My focus is on developing responsive, easy to use Web 2.0 applications on N+1 architectures using Java, J2EE, SQL, XML/XHTML and JavaScript. I leverage my expertise in web application development, software architecture, and model- and test-driven development.

positions.title: Chief Software Architect
positions.description:
*  Maintain ultimate responsibility for all networks, servers, applications and infrastructure for the business
    * Provide technical leadership for product development, system administration, and help-desk staff
    * Served as lead in the design and implementation of a web based applications suite tailored for the capital equipment finance industry
    * Manage product development methodology and project plans for multi-generational product releases
    * Defined product-line architecture for end-to-end, multi-party on-line equipment leasing solution
    * Envisioned architecture and implemented single sign-on integration between Captara ASP and client domains
    * Provided database administration for enterprise Oracle and MySQL databases
    * Initiated adoption of Model Driven Architecture and Code Generation techniques to accelerate product development time-to-delivery

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Market Development Engineering for Java Fund Startups, Performance and Scale Testing of ExactVM JVM, Strategic Planning for SAIL team, Sustaining Engineering support for NEO ORB.

organizations.description: The Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics (SIAM) was incorporated in 1952 as a nonprofit organization to convey useful mathematical knowledge to other professionals who could implement mathematical theory for practical, industrial, or scientific use. I support and contribute towards the advancement of the society's goals, and heartily imbibe of its fine bookshop.
